description: We are KAWSAY SPACE team, young innovators passionate about science, technology, and space exploration. We chose this challenge because astronaut health is vital for future missions. Our platform monitors astronauts' health, identifies potential risks, and provides medical guidance. Our goal is to promote safer space exploration through innovation and science.
summary: KAWSAY SPACE is an intelligent health-monitoring platform designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. Working alongside a biometric shirt, it collects vital-sign data and processes it to provide continuous health monitoring, interactive visualizations, and early alerts for potential abnormalities. By bringing health information together in a single platform, KAWSAY SPACE helps identify possible warning signs and provides guidance to support astronauts when immediate medical assistance from Earth may be limited. The project addresses the health challenges of space exploration, where microgravity, radiation, isolation, and distance from Earth can make medical monitoring more difficult. Beyond space missions, our vision is to adapt this technology for everyday use, helping people on Earth monitor their health. Ultimately, KAWSAY SPACE aims to make health monitoring more accessible and contribute to safer space exploration and better health management on Earth.
details:
KAWSAY SPACE

A New Approach to Human Health in Space

Space exploration pushes the limits of human endurance. During long-duration missions, astronauts face physiological and psychological challenges caused by microgravity, radiation exposure, isolation, and confinement. These conditions make continuous health monitoring essential, especially when immediate medical assistance from Earth is limited.

KAWSAY SPACE addresses this challenge through an intelligent health-monitoring platform that integrates wearable biometric technology, data analysis, and digital health assistance. Its purpose is to transform physiological information into clear, useful insights that support astronauts in understanding and monitoring their health.

From Biological Signals to Meaningful Information

At the center of KAWSAY SPACE is the connection between a biometric shirt and a digital platform. The wearable technology is designed to collect physiological information, while the software organizes, processes, and presents this information through an interactive interface.

Rather than treating each health indicator separately, the platform brings different dimensions of human well-being together:

  • Physiological Monitoring: Tracks vital indicators such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, body temperature, respiratory activity, sleep, and physical activity, depending on the available sensors.
  • Health Pattern Analysis: Examines changes in collected information to identify unusual patterns that may require attention.
  • Well-being Assessment: Considers physical and emotional well-being, incorporating available physiological information and user-reported experiences.
  • Intelligent Medical Guidance: Provides accessible explanations and recommendations based on validated medical protocols, helping astronauts understand potential health concerns.
  • Environmental Support: Explores ways to adapt environmental conditions, such as lighting, to promote comfort and healthy rest.

A Platform Designed Around the Astronaut

KAWSAY SPACE is intended to make health information easier to understand and act upon. Its interactive dashboards bring important indicators together, allowing astronauts to observe changes, follow their health trends, and receive alerts when potentially abnormal patterns are detected.

This approach supports preventive health management rather than relying exclusively on medical intervention after a problem develops. It does not replace professional medical diagnosis; instead, it aims to provide an additional layer of monitoring and decision support.

Technology with a Purpose Beyond Earth

Although KAWSAY SPACE was conceived to address the challenges of human space exploration, its potential applications extend beyond spacecraft.

The same approach to wearable monitoring and health-data visualization could be adapted for people on Earth. By making physiological information more accessible and understandable, the project envisions a future in which individuals can become more aware of their health and recognize potential warning signs earlier.

Our Vision

Our vision is to contribute to a future where distance from Earth does not mean distance from medical support. We want to help make long-duration space missions safer by giving astronauts better tools to understand and monitor their health.

At the same time, we believe that innovations developed for space exploration can inspire solutions that benefit humanity on Earth. KAWSAY SPACE represents this connection: technology designed to protect human life, wherever exploration takes us.
